data.title: Empty names crash the profile page
story: Profile pictures are replaced by the first letter of the user name. Users who have not filled in a name make the profile page crash.
There is a hidden test for that edge case. Think: does empty text have a first letter?

explanation: Empty text has no first letter, so name[0] raises an IndexError. Check the length first and return "?" for that edge case.
hints: What happens if you run ""[0] in Python?
For an empty name, return "?" before reading name[0].
